b.request: For scans with chronotag strictly between 2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274 and 2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797 (excluding boundary values), grouped by zoneref and typesite, return one row with the unrounded average of per-group average compression ratios and the unrounded average of per-group average size-per-minute rates, ignoring null values.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg_pressure) as avg_compression_ratio, AVG(group_avg_rate) as avg_size_per_minute FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) as group_avg_pressure, AVG(CASE WHEN s.spanmin > 0 THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin ELSE NULL END) as group_avg_rate FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite) subquery

d.request: Scans with chronotag strictly between (excluding) '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', filtered by zoneref presence, grouped by zoneref and typesite, returning the unrounded mean of per-group mean pressratio values and the unrounded mean of per-group mean (gbsize/spanmin) values, with null values ignored per calculation.
d.sql: WITH filtered_scans AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.chronotag, s.pressratio, s.gbsize, s.spanmin, si.typesite FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.zoneref IS NOT NULL), group_means AS (SELECT zoneref, typesite, AVG(pressratio) as mean_pressratio, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) as mean_ratio FROM filtered_scans GROUP BY zoneref, typesite) SELECT AVG(mean_pressratio) as mean_of_mean_pressratio, AVG(mean_ratio) as mean_of_mean_ratio FROM group_means;

a.request: Take the scans whose timestamp (`chronotag`, compared as text) is strictly after '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly before '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', with both endpoints excluded, and keep only scans that match a site by site code. Group them by scan zone reference (`zoneref`) and site type (`typesite`). For each group, work out the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) and the average of file size divided by scan duration (`gbsize` / `spanmin`), ignoring missing values. Then give me one row with two unrounded values: the average of those per-group compression-ratio averages and the average of the per-group size-per-minute averages.
a.sql:
WITH filtered_scans AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    st.typesite,
    s.pressratio,
    CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 
         THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin 
         ELSE NULL 
    END as size_per_minute
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(pressratio) as avg_pressratio,
    AVG(size_per_minute) as avg_size_per_minute
  FROM filtered_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, typesite
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pressratio) as avg_compression_ratio,
  AVG(avg_size_per_minute) as avg_size_per_minute
FROM group_averages

c.request: For scans taken between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (comparing the `chronotag` text), and only those linked to a site by site code, group by zone reference (`zoneref`) and site type (`typesite`). For each group, get the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) and the average of file size divided by scan duration (`gbsize` / `spanmin`), ignoring missing values. Then give me one row with two unrounded values: the average of the per-group compression-ratio averages and the average of the per-group size-per-minute averages. Scans whose timestamp equals either boundary value are left out. Only scans strictly between the two bounds count.
c.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_compression_ratio), AVG(avg_size_per_min) FROM group_averages;
